preconditions: The owner requests the dataset through the authors' licence agreement (academic research, non-commercial); acquisition is never automated.
The release archive's SHA-256 is recorded on intake; the manifest is frozen from the extracted tree.

exposure.basis: The phase-1 detector trains on COCO 2017 only. Public plate recognisers (the measuring instruments) may have trained on UFPR-ALPR; each instrument's exposure is recorded in its specification.

researchUse.basis: The authors release UFPR-ALPR for academic research only, free to researchers at educational or research institutes for non-commercial purposes, under a licence agreement the owner signs. Development benchmarking is research evaluation; nothing is redistributed.
